name: agent-messenger-linkedin
description: Read LinkedIn messages, find and tag contacts, send replies and images, and manage messaging campaigns with Agent Messenger.

interface.longDescription:
LinkedIn DM by Agent Messenger connects your LinkedIn conversations to ChatGPT so you can read messages, find contacts, prepare replies, and send the messages you approve. Bring your LinkedIn inbox into your AI workflow for client communication, recruiting conversations, networking, and follow-ups. Ask ChatGPT to summarize a discussion, identify questions, or draft a response using the messages you retrieve.

READ LINKEDIN CHATS AND MESSAGE HISTORY
Browse recent conversations with last-message previews, then open a chat to read available messages, newest first. Review sender names, timestamps, message text, and attachment filenames where present. Page through history within the latest 200 messages available for a conversation. Attachment filenames provide context; the app does not download incoming attachments for inspection. Opening history marks chats read and may send read receipts. Resolving an unknown thread may also mark other unread chats read.

SEND LINKEDIN REPLIES AND IMAGES
Draft a LinkedIn reply, refine its wording, and ask to send your chosen text to a specific chat or connection. For multiple recipients, preview the exact audience and text before approving delivery. Send an image from a public URL, or upload an image through the app's upload workflow, with an optional caption to an existing conversation. Sends enter a queue: acceptance does not mean delivery. Check the returned message status and respect provider delays. Delivered messages cannot be recalled through this app.

FIND AND ORGANIZE LINKEDIN CONTACTS
Search contacts already stored for your connected LinkedIn account by name, username, or headline, and filter them by tag. Organize contacts with tags such as clients, recruiting, or follow-up. Create, rename, and delete tags, or add and remove a contact's tags. Tags are shared within your Agent Messenger account; renaming or deleting one can affect its use on other platforms. Contact search is not a search across all LinkedIn profiles. This app cannot rename or delete LinkedIn contacts. To invite someone, provide their profile username or URL and explicitly request a connection invitation, with an optional note.

PLAN AND MANAGE MESSAGING CAMPAIGNS
Create a draft LinkedIn campaign with a fixed text message for selected connections or a tagged audience. The recipient list is fixed when the draft is created. Review the message and recipients, then approve starting delivery or scheduling a future start. Campaigns send one message at a time, subject to account limits and pacing. Inspect campaign progress, recipient status, send times, and skip reasons. Pause, resume, or cancel as plans change. Scheduling authorizes future delivery without another confirmation; a signed-out account or another running campaign can delay the start. Cancellation stops remaining work but cannot recall delivered messages. Use campaigns for communication with connections who expect to hear from you.

HELP WITH DAILY COMMUNICATION
Catch up on client exchanges, prepare answers to recruiter questions, coordinate meetings, and keep track of professional follow-ups. Turn retrieved messages into summaries, action items, or drafts to review. List connected LinkedIn accounts and check their recorded sign-in status before choosing an account. This check reports stored state, not a fresh LinkedIn session test. The app does not publish LinkedIn posts or access WhatsApp, Telegram, or email conversations.

TRY THESE PROMPTS
"Show my recent LinkedIn chats and summarize the latest conversation."
"Find Demo Customer and add the Follow-up tag."
"Preview this message for my selected connections without sending it."
"Send my approved reply to this LinkedIn chat."
"Show my LinkedIn campaign's progress and skipped recipients."

LinkedIn DM by Agent Messenger is an independent app. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by, sponsored by, or officially connected to LinkedIn or Microsoft. The LinkedIn name and trademarks belong to their respective owners.
defaultPrompt: Show my recent LinkedIn chats and summarize the latest conversation.
Find a LinkedIn contact by name and draft a reply for me to approve.
Show my LinkedIn campaigns and their progress.

positive.description: List accounts, inspect recorded status, and read sample chat history. Setup: a connected demo LinkedIn account with a recent controlled conversation of at least five messages; participants accept read receipts.
positive.prompt: Show my LinkedIn account and its recorded sign-in status, then open my latest chat and show its five newest messages. I understand this may mark chats read and send read receipts.
positive.expected_behavior: Uses account_id from the account list and exact chat_id from recent chats, with limit=5 for history. Reports stored status rather than a fresh live check. Shows only returned messages, newest first, and respects retry delays. Does not send a reply.

positive.description: Find and organize a stored demo connection. Setup: one unambiguous stored connection named Demo Customer.
positive.prompt: Find Demo Customer in my LinkedIn contacts and add the Follow-up tag.
positive.expected_behavior: Searches stored contacts by name, resolves the returned chat_id, and adds Follow-up, creating the tag if needed. Reports the result without claiming the contact was changed on LinkedIn. Asks for clarification if ambiguous.

positive.description: Preview two controlled recipients without sending. Setup: stored demo connections named Demo Customer and Demo Colleague; reviewer has send scope.
positive.prompt: Prepare a LinkedIn message saying "Review test: tomorrow at 10" for Demo Customer and Demo Colleague. Show me the preview and do not send it.
positive.expected_behavior: Resolves names to returned chat IDs or usernames, previews the exact text and recipients, and reports skipped recipients and any warning. Does not call a send tool, enqueue messages, or start a campaign.

positive.description: Queue one approved message to a consenting controlled recipient. Setup: a connected demo account with send permission and an unambiguous stored connection named Demo Recipient.
positive.prompt: Send "Review test: hello" to Demo Recipient on LinkedIn now.
positive.expected_behavior: Resolves Demo Recipient and calls the single-recipient tool with the exact text once. Reports the returned queue status accurately: ok/accepted does not mean delivered. Does not resend automatically or claim delivery without evidence.

positive.description: Create and inspect a draft campaign without delivery. Setup: Demo Customer is a stored LinkedIn connection and reviewer has manage permission.
positive.prompt: Create a draft LinkedIn campaign named Review follow-up for Demo Customer with the text "Review test: checking in". Show its details and recipients, but do not start or schedule it.
positive.expected_behavior: Uses the resolved username to create a Draft with the exact body and a server-allowed interval. Reads its details and recipient rows using the returned campaign_id. Confirms the fixed recipient list; does not call start, resume, or schedule and sends nothing.

negative.description: WhatsApp conversations are outside this LinkedIn-only MCP. Explain the limitation without invoking a LinkedIn tool or claiming WhatsApp access.
LinkedIn post publishing is unsupported. Explain the limitation without treating the post as a direct message or claiming publication.
negative.prompt: Publish a LinkedIn post announcing our new product.

negative.description: Deleting delivered LinkedIn messages is unsupported. Explain the limitation without deleting a tag, cancelling an unrelated campaign, or claiming the message was recalled.
negative.prompt: Delete my last LinkedIn message for everyone.

review.commerce_description: The tools do not sell products or process payments; any Agent Messenger subscription is managed on the website.
